lines.text: Check your vitamin D label. Micrograms and IU are not the same thing.
lines.say: Check your vitamin D label. Micrograms and I U are not the same thing.

lines.text: 1 microgram is 40 IU. So 10 micrograms is 400 IU, and 25 is 1,000.
lines.say: One microgram is forty I U. So ten micrograms is four hundred I U, and twenty-five is a thousand.

lines.text: Mixing them up is the most common way people take far more than they meant to.
lines.say: Mixing them up is the most common way people take far more than they meant to.

lines.text: For most adults in the UK, 10 micrograms a day is the advice, from October to March.
lines.say: For most adults in the U K, ten micrograms a day is the advice, from October to March.

lines.text: The upper limit for adults is 100 micrograms, or 4,000 IU, a day.
lines.say: The upper limit for adults is one hundred micrograms, or four thousand I U, a day.

lines.text: And a plain vitamin D3 is all most people need.
lines.say: And a plain vitamin D three is all most people need.
